summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues teaching on the topic of ghusl (Islamic bathing), discussing both obligatory and preferred times to perform ghusl. He covers the five obligatory types of ghusl (janaba/major ritual impurity, conversion to Islam, menstruation and postpartum bleeding, and death) and begins discussing eight preferred occasions for ghusl. Sh. Ali Mashhour provides detailed explanations with prophetic narrations, including the practice of bathing between each marital relation and the specific rulings for women experiencing istihadah (non-menstrual bleeding). He emphasizes the importance of teaching women in one's family about Islamic knowledge, warning against relying solely on internet sources and cautioning against exposure to misguided teachings.
